eyebrow: The cut list: pre-committing to what gets dropped
code:
1. Very short on time:
   drop the 5-qubit extension;
   report the 3-qubit repro alone
2. Moderately short:
   keep both, reduce shot count
   per condition
3. Time allows:
   add a third qubit count
   as a bonus, not a requirement
caption: Decided now, while not under time pressure -- so a crunch is "execute step 1," not a scramble.
